comparison_unit: One physical source frame. Hold out complete recordings separately within each source platform. Score calibrated arms only if that platform has another recording. A fold with a missing training class uses a constant classification from the available training class. A fold with no verified binary labels retains D's always-accept rule.
identity: Independently assign dense sampled points to a unique annotated box using original source metadata. Candidate ownership uses the final oriented D box. It requires at least three uniquely owned points, at least 55% of contained points with that owner, and a 15% lead over the runner-up or unassigned points. Independently verified same-side distractors must have the same official annotated class and at least 0.014 normalized camera-x gap in the specified direction from the annotated subject.
true_absence: Only a visually resolved reference with at least six uniquely assigned points qualifies for an absence assessment. A verified owner in a final oriented D box means covered. Otherwise, if either a raw or final D box has at least 0.15 3D IoU or contains at least three unique reference points and 15% of all reference points, its coverage is ambiguous. In the absence of all such support it is a natural miss. Visually unresolved and physically ambiguous frames remain separate and in the original sample count.
rank: Use the unchanged D unary as offset. Fit three bounded coefficients in [-2,2] by paired logistic loss with 0.15 L2, weight each training frame equally, using the highest original D unary within each verified physical identity. At test time use the maximum score within each identity. Measure strict wins, ties, losses, and frame-macro pairwise concordance over individually verified foils represented in the same D pool. This ranking is evaluated prior to rejection.
unknown: Fit balanced logistic regression on physically covered versus natural missing in other recordings with 0.15 L2 on slopes standardized on training data. Use a probability-of-missing cutoff of 0.5. D-only uses D top probability, top-two gap and candidate count. The new arm and shifted control add exactly three aligned or reassigned features at the original D winner. Output UNKNOWN only at the cutoff. Evaluation includes missing recall, covered false rejection, and correct accepted reference on all physically covered frames.
gate: Evaluate within source platform without pooling dependent observations across recordings. Evaluate the matching-control ranking and rejection comparisons on identical frames. As specified in protocol.json, a stronger rank signal and better natural miss rejection with no net loss of correct covered outputs must both be supported on held-out recordings before any joint experiment. Also report cases where some training folds have no labels, lack either rejection class, or lack hard pair supervision.
